data.title: 黑歌 · 隐秘温泉的敏感抚触
data.description: 露天温泉水汽缭绕，黑发与猫耳湿漉漉地贴在泛红的面颊上。当敏感的猫耳根部与双尾被你在水中轻抚时，平日散漫的黑歌浑身剧颤，带着娇喘水汪汪地把你拉入怀中。
data.location: private natural rock hot spring shrouded in steam
data.action: soaking in steamy hot spring water, wet cat ears trembling delightfully, twin tails floating in water, breathless flushed moans
data.lighting: steamy warm lantern glow reflecting on glistening water ripples
data.mood: steamy sensual ecstasy, sensitive feline vulnerability, loving surrender
data.promptProse: Soaking in a steamy private onsen with untied bikini, Kuroka shivers in ecstatic pleasure as her sensitive cat ears are lovingly stroked.
data.animaCaption: Kuroka shivering delightfully while soaking in a steamy private onsen.
